;;;767            uint16_t remaining = s_isotp_conn.rx_total_len - s_isotp_conn.rx_received_len;

;;;775            s_isotp_conn.rx_expected_seq = (s_isotp_conn.rx_expected_seq + 1) & 0x0F;

;;;778            s_isotp_conn.rx_timeout_counter = s_isotp_conn.timeout_ms;
